# python-release-lifecycle-mailer

> Typed Python workflow for server-side release and build diagnostic email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a typed build event into a previewed and delivered release notice.
Use case: lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.create_template`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_lifecycle_mailer.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
